source_gap_claims.behavior: The authoring standard must define one primary responsibility, triggers, non-goals, I/O, dependencies, references, tests, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries.
source_gap_claims.reason: No operative obligation requires this complete set of standard declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Standard declaration sections

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must reject a governed fixture when any required declaration or referenced section is missing.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations do not require rejection of fixtures missing a required declared section or referenced section.
source_gap_claims.subject: Required-section validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: For a missing declaration or referenced section, validation must identify the applicable rule and relative location, and headings alone must not satisfy the check.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires rule/location diagnostics for missing sections or rejects heading-only compliance.
source_gap_claims.subject: Section diagnostic precision

source_gap_claims.behavior: The versioned quality-contract schema must accept a valid contract.
source_gap_claims.reason: Schema validation against a reference package does not require acceptance semantics for a valid quality contract.
source_gap_claims.subject: Valid quality-contract schema

source_gap_claims.behavior: The quality-contract schema must reject unsupported versions, malformed types, undeclared fields in its owned quality namespace, and unresolved references.
source_gap_claims.reason: The complete obligations do not require these quality-contract schema rejection cases.
source_gap_claims.subject: Quality-contract schema rejection

source_gap_claims.behavior: Capabilities must be recorded explicitly; a capability typo or schema-version typo must fail rather than silently becoming an empty or disabled capability.
source_gap_claims.reason: Composed-capability checks and policy/schema validation do not require explicit capability recording or this typo handling behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Explicit capability recording

source_gap_claims.behavior: Frontmatter validation must require nonempty name and description, a canonical package name, and consistency between that package name and the declared Skill identity.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires these frontmatter identity and nonempty-field checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Frontmatter identity validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must reject missing or malformed frontmatter, duplicate keys, conflicting names, and unsupported frontmatter extensions.
source_gap_claims.reason: Documentation about unsupported frontmatter does not establish these validator rejection behaviors, and no other obligation covers them.
source_gap_claims.subject: Frontmatter failure handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must enforce fewer than 500 logical lines in SKILL.md, counting frontmatter, blank lines, and code blocks, with 499 passing and 500 or 501 failing; LF and CRLF must count identically and a final newline must not add a line.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation specifies the SKILL.md logical-line limit or its boundary and newline-counting oracle.
source_gap_claims.subject: SKILL.md logical-line limit

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard must recommend a smaller main file without introducing a second hard size gate.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations do not require this recommendation or explicitly prohibit a second hard gate.
source_gap_claims.subject: Main-file size guidance
